title: WhatsApp Without Saving a Contact
description: *WhatsApp Without Saving a Contact* is a **one-screen web tool** that opens a WhatsApp chat with any number. Pick the country, type the number, open the chat.

I set the concept and the usability bar: one selector, one field, one button, nothing else. The page is **responsive**, preselects your country from the browser locale, and fills itself in from a pasted international number.
The number rules are **covered by tests written before the code**: 227 dial codes, the E.164 length limit, and the trunk zero that Italy keeps. Nothing leaves the browser.
